s142.sec5.u0: Now, which one is the winner?
s142.sec7.u0: Only one in three is a winner!
s145.sec5.u0: You! No more mischief, got it?
s145.sec5.u2: Hm, looks like this is the last room.
s145.sec5.u4: That voice... WaruMonzaemon! A big box and a small box, huh? Heh, I see right through you!
s145.sec5.u6: Bwah ha ha ha! Dummy, dummy! Wroooong!
s145.sec5.u7: Sooo you saw through it, huh! Heh heh heh. Did your heart skip a beat?
s145.sec5.u8: Dang it! Quit messing with me!
s145.sec5.u9: My, my, aren't we feisty? So what do you want? Here to become one of my underlings? Heh heh.
s145.sec5.u10: Give back the friend you kidnapped!
s145.sec5.u11: A friend? Don't know what you mean. Do I look like the type to do that?
s145.sec5.u13: Bwah ha ha! I do? Ding ding ding! Yeees, it was meee! But I'm not giving it back. I mean, I'm WaruMonzaemon, right?
s145.sec5.u14: If that's how it is, I'll take it by force!
s145.sec5.u15: Eh? Eh? What's that? Was that a joke? You, beat me? Oh, I see. Uh-huh. Tsk tsk, you really need to face reality!
s145.sec5.u16: Now give back the friend you kidnapped.
s145.sec5.u17: Gwaaah... so strong... no waaay... I can't lose to yooou...
s145.sec5.u19: Fiiine, have it your way. Here.
s145.sec5.u20: Huh? Waaaaah... Hey, wait a minute!
s145.sec5.u22: It was just a joke, okay? Here's the real one!
s145.sec5.u23: Hey, what's this? It's just a gear.
s145.sec5.u27: Guess I'll take it back for now...
s145.sec5.u28: You! No more mischief, got it?
s145.sec5.u30: Ugh, I don't believe you. But I can't waste all my time on you.
s145.sec5.u31: Oh no, I'm carrying too many items. I need to throw something out.
